statements.impact_statement: The image replaces Debian's SQLite 3.46.1 with the official SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation, verified against the published SHA3-256. Upstream fixed the FTS5 doclist merge overflow in 3.54.0. verify_sqlite.py checks the loaded version and exercises negative-rowid detail=none prefix queries in the final image. This version is packaged locally; Debian has not recorded a fixed distribution version yet.

This vulnerability is in the SQLite CLI .recover dot-command. build-sqlite.sh compiles only sqlite3.c into a shared library; shell.c is not compiled or installed. The final distroless image contains no SQLite CLI, and verify_sqlite.py checks the executable locations. The Python sqlite3 module and FTS5 remain available.

The locally built SQLite 3.54.1 includes upstream fix d9de6eedbe918c074c7556400fa21df5960704d9 for the FTS5 secure-delete heap overflow, released in 3.54.0. Debian confirms the upstream fix at https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119374. build-sqlite.sh checks the official source SHA3-256; verify_sqlite.py verifies the loaded version and FTS5 in the final image. This statement matches only the locally built package version; Debian trixie has no fixed distribution package yet.

The locally built SQLite 3.54.1 includes upstream fix 64459c87cc702d600704fb77ee40ca1782398a52 for the session changeset heap overflow, released in 3.54.0. Debian confirms the upstream fix at https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119379. build-sqlite.sh checks the official source SHA3-256; verify_sqlite.py verifies the loaded version and FTS5 in the final image.
